intelligence.simple_view: Imagine one list of ten — ten problems, and right next to each one, how we fix it, told by Naya herself. And imagine a circle: you share something good, it comes back to you, and it keeps going around, getting bigger every time. That is the page, and that is the whole idea.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, never hand someone your rough notes and call it finished — take your words, think them through, and shape them into the clearest, kindest version before anyone reads them. And when you build something, build it so every piece fits with the others; a piece that doesn't fit isn't finished yet.
